en.headline: Police arrest company director and two engineers over lift works deficiencies
en.dek: New Territories South Regional Crime Unit detained three men aged 63 to 82 after EMSD referred findings of missing fire-door frames at two estates.
body: Police arrested three men on Friday in connection with alleged serious deficiencies in lift replacement works at two Tenants Purchase Scheme estates, the New Territories South Regional Crime Unit said.

The arrests followed a referral by the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department, which earlier reported that Tai Yip Elevator (Hong Kong) Limited had installed fire-resistant doors on 48 lifts at Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong and Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin but omitted the required door-frame components before declaring the works complete.

According to police sources, the three men include a 79-year-old director and shareholder of the company, an 82-year-old registered escalator engineer employed by the firm, and a 63-year-old registered escalator engineer who served as an external consultant. Officers searched the company's office in Chai Wan Industrial City and seized documents.

The department has said the lifts remain safe to operate and ordered the company to complete remedial installation of the missing frames within one month. It is also inspecting other lifts installed by the same contractor across Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕臺日電梯董事及兩名註冊工程師 涉升降機工程缺失
zh.dek: 新界南總區重案組拘捕三名63至82歲男子，機電署早前轉介兩屋邨耐火門框組件未裝便報完工的個案。
body: 警方新界南總區重案組周五拘捕三名男子，涉兩座租者置其屋計劃屋邨的升降機更換工程出現嚴重缺失。
機電工程署早前公布，臺日電梯（香港）有限公司在觀塘翠屏北邨及沙田博康邨更換的48部升降機中，只安裝耐火門，卻沒有安裝相關門框組件便報稱完工，並將事件轉介警方跟進。
消息指，被捕三人包括公司79歲董事兼股東、82歲註冊自動梯工程師兼公司僱員，以及63歲外聘顧問、同樣為註冊自動梯工程師。探員到柴灣工業城公司辦公室蒐證，檢走文件。
機電署表示涉事升降機仍可安全運作，已要求承辦商一個月內完成加裝門框組件，並正巡查全港由該公司安裝的其他升降機。
